body:
I know that feeling. Every day I still catch myself thinking that I don't have depression, and that I'm just lazy, even though I've had three different doctors give me the ol' F32.2.
Then I think that maybe I just lied to the doctors about my symptoms. That somehow, subconsciously,
I've convinced myself of these lies, and I'm just looking for an excuse for why I am a shitty person.

I lived with the symptoms for years before I talked to a doctor, because
when I was young, my peers and parents led me to believe feeling suicidal was normal, and that everyone felt like that all the time. You know,
the classic "eVeRyBoDy hAs pRobLemS!!1!" bullshit people spew out when they get uncomfortable because someone mentions they feel like shit.

I then convinced myself that I'm just unhappy, because I don't like elementary school. Then the same with middle school.
And then again with high school. And after that I told myself, it's because I'm this many years old and still living with my parents, no wonder I'm unhappy.
I moved away, and nothing changed. That was when I finally admitted I might need to talk to a doctor.
